name: Pit Imp
text: Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
flavor: It is small, it is spiteful, and it is never where you swing.

name: Tomb Crawler

flavor: Its touch carries the cold of every grave it has crawled from.

name: Famished Ghoul

flavor: The closer you come to the grave, the better it can smell you.

name: Hellmaw Hound
text: Dread (This creature can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.)
flavor: Honest dogs bolt at its scent. Only the damned dare stand in its path.

name: Grave Chanter
text: When Grave Chanter enters, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

text: Sacrifice another Zombie: Charnel Glutton gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

name: Ossuary Bone-Walker

flavor: Break it apart and the pieces keep walking.

name: Pit-Chained Fiend

name: Barrow Wight
text: Dread (This creature can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.)
flavor: It still wears the gold it was buried with, and it wants yours.

name: Grave Chill
text: Target enemy creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
flavor: The cold of the crypt does not stay in the crypt.

name: Wither the Living
text: Destroy target enemy creature with power 2 or less.
flavor: "Life is short. That is why you must take other people's." (a Pact preacher)

name: Bargain in Blood
text: Draw two cards. You lose 2 life.
flavor: "Sin is only a debt, and debts are for the poor." (the Pact catechism)

name: Siphon of Ashes
text: The enemy player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
flavor: "Charity is theft from yourself. Take, and call it balance." (the Black Synod)

name: Dread Whisper
text: The enemy player discards two cards at random.
flavor: "A lie told at the right hour is worth a hundred truths told too late." (Malgrith, Lich of the Black Ledger)

name: Unquiet Grave
text: Return target creature card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to play.
flavor: Rest was promised to him. The Pact does not honour other men's promises.

name: Black Altar

abilities.text: Sacrifice a creature: The enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

text: Sacrifice a creature: The enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

text: Tap, Pay 1 life: Target enemy creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

name: Lych-Gate Shambler
text: Lych-Gate Shambler gets +1/+0 for each other Zombie you control.
flavor: It waits by the lych-gate for the next funeral, and it is never alone for long.

name: Cackling Imp
text: Whenever another Demon enters under your control, target enemy creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

name: Bone-Rattle Picket
text: When Bone-Rattle Picket dies, create a 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton token.
flavor: Knock it down and something else climbs out of the same grave.

name: Sulphur Brute
text: When Sulphur Brute enters, you lose 1 life.
flavor: It comes up through the cellar floor, and the whole house smells of the pit for a week.

name: Chill of the Charnel Host
text: Target enemy creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each Skeleton you control.
flavor: One dead hand is cold. A hundred bony hands are the grave itself.

name: Tithe of the Pit
text: Draw a card for each Demon you control. You lose 1 life for each Demon you control.
flavor: "The Pact asks only a tenth of you. Then a tenth of what remains. Then a tenth of that." (a Pact tithe-collector)

name: Marsh-Light Shade
text: Dread (This creature can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.)
flavor: Travellers follow its pale lantern off the causeway, and the fen keeps them.

name: Plague-Pit Shambler
text: When Plague-Pit Shambler dies, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: They tipped him into the plague pit with the others. He did not stay with them.

name: Gravepit Ghoul
text: When Gravepit Ghoul enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
flavor: It digs all night in the churchyard, and what it digs up follows it home.

name: Grave-Dust Skirmisher

flavor: "Why wait for judgment to rise? I dug him up on Tuesday, and he only has to last till supper." (Morvane, a Pact sexton)

name: Empty the Bone-Pits
text: Create three 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton tokens.
flavor: "Count the bones, never the souls. Bones obey, and souls keep asking where it all went wrong." (Ledger-Keeper Ossric)

name: Bone-Priest of the Pact

abilities.text: Sacrifice another creature: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.

text: Sacrifice another creature: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.

text: Whenever Wailing Wraith attacks, target enemy creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
flavor: Its cry finds the weak place in every heart and widens it.

name: Veiled Blade of the Pact
text: Deathtouch, dread.
flavor: "Murder is such a vulgar word. We say early settlement." (a Pact paymaster)

name: Cinder-Pit Fiend
text: Dread. At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.
flavor: "Gratitude is a tax, and the Pact is exempt." (the Pact catechism)

name: Tempter of Broken Vows
text: When Tempter of Broken Vows enters or dies, the enemy player discards a card at random.

text: Pay 2 life: Blood-Bound Reaver gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

flavor: "Rise. Your rest was never part of the bargain."

name: Unmaking Rite
text: Destroy target enemy creature. You lose 2 life.
flavor: "Mercy is a debt owed to the weak, and the Pact never pays its debts." (the Black Synod)

name: Breath of the Ossuary
text: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
flavor: The old bones sigh, and everything that lives grows a little lighter.

name: The Debt Comes Due
text: Bloodied: If you have 5 or less life, the enemy player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. Then the enemy player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
flavor: The contract was always clear. It was only written very small.

name: Chalice of Black Vows
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: "Drink. Guilt is only a thirst you have not yet satisfied." (a Pact cupbearer)

name: Knife of the Black Tithe

abilities.text: Sacrifice a creature: Target enemy creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.

text: Sacrifice a creature: Target enemy creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
flavor: One life for the knife, one for the curse. The arithmetic of the pit is simple.

abilities.text: {2}, Tap, Pay 2 life: The enemy player discards a card at random.

text: {2}, Tap, Pay 2 life: The enemy player discards a card at random.
flavor: Its smoke mocks the incense of the sanctuary. It carries no prayers up, only thoughts away.

name: Drummer of the Dead March
text: Other Skeletons you control get +1/+0.
flavor: He beats a drum of stretched hide, and every grave in the parish keeps time.

name: Herald of the Burning Gate
text: Your Demon creature cards cost {1} less to play. This effect reduces only generic mana.
flavor: "Every man serves someone. Serve the one with the bigger fire." (Herald of the Burning Gate)

name: Gravecaller Bone-Warden
text: Whenever another Skeleton enters under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Gravecaller Bone-Warden.
flavor: Every skeleton that climbs out of the earth lends him a little more of its cold.

name: Brimstone Exhalation
text: All enemy creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn for each Demon you control.
flavor: The fiends breathe out together, and the field below them chokes.

name: Corpse-Bell of the Barrow
text: Whenever a Zombie you control dies, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: It was cast to ring the dead to rest. The Pact recast it to ring them up again.

name: Plague-Cart Drover
text: When Plague-Cart Drover dies, create two 1/1 Restless Dead Zombie tokens.
flavor: "Bring out your dead," he croaks, and the dead in his cart climb down to help.

name: Hunger of the Grave
text: The enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life for each Zombie you control.
flavor: The dead are never fed. They only take, a mouthful of warmth at a time.

name: Rattling Grave-Raider
text: When Rattling Grave-Raider dies, create a 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton token. Unearth {2}{B} ({2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)
flavor: "A grave is only a purse the dead forgot to lock." (Ulric Vane, grave-robber of the Pact)

name: Twice-Buried Ghoul
text: When Twice-Buried Ghoul enters, create a 1/1 Restless Dead Zombie token. Unearth {2}{B} ({2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)
flavor: "He was buried once for his sins and once for his debts. I dug him up for both, and charged him twice." (Morvane, a Pact sexton)

name: Oathbreaker Knight
text: Bloodied: As long as you have 5 or less life, Oathbreaker Knight gets +2/+2 and has dread and deathtouch.
flavor: "Honour was a fine horse. I sold it and bought ten mercenaries." (Oathbreaker Knight)

name: Dream-Thief Fiend
text: Flying. Whenever Dream-Thief Fiend attacks, the enemy player discards a card at random.
flavor: In the morning you remember that you had a plan. You cannot remember what it was.

name: Marquis of the Wailing Pit

flavor: "Better feared than loved, and better paid than feared." (Marquis of the Wailing Pit)

name: Hollow-Crowned Lich
text: Deathtouch. At the beginning of your upkeep, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: "Why fear the judgement? I have simply arranged never to arrive at it." (Hollow-Crowned Lich)

name: Bone-Lord of the Ossuary

abilities.text: {B}, Sacrifice another creature: Create a 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton token.

text: Other Skeletons you control get +1/+1. {B}, Sacrifice another creature: Create a 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton token.
flavor: Every skull on his walls once knelt to him. Most of them still do.

name: Profane Resurrection
text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to play. You lose 2 life.
flavor: A mockery of the true rising. The body walks, and nothing looks out of its eyes.

name: Night of Unmaking
text: Destroy all creatures.
flavor: "Leave no witness, and the deed was never done." (the Black Synod, Canon of Silence)

name: Rite of the Emptied Mind
text: The enemy player discards three cards at random. You lose 3 life.
flavor: "An empty mind is a free mind. An empty soul is freer still." (the Pact catechism)

name: Ledger of the Damned

abilities.text: Tap: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.

text: Tap: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
flavor: "Every soul has its price. The trick is to buy before he learns it." (Malgrith, Lich of the Black Ledger)

name: Barrow-King of the Hollow Hills
text: Other Skeletons you control have dread. (They can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.) When Barrow-King of the Hollow Hills enters, create two 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton tokens.
flavor: When he rides out of the hill at midnight, his host walks where no living man can stop it.

name: Brimstone Marshal
text: Other Demons you control get +1/+1. When Brimstone Marshal enters, you lose 1 life for each Demon you control.
flavor: "Never ask a recruit why he joined. Ask him what he still owes." (Brimstone Marshal)

name: Ghoul-Master of the Plague Pits
text: Other Zombies you control get +1/+1. When Ghoul-Master of the Plague Pits dies, create a 1/1 Restless Dead Zombie token.
flavor: He was the parish gravedigger in the year of the plague. He still keeps the pits, and the pits keep him.

name: Belzareth, Prince of Cinders
text: Flying. When Belzareth enters, destroy target enemy creature and you lose 3 life.
flavor: "I did not fall. I merely went into business for myself." (Belzareth, Prince of Cinders)

name: Malgrith, Lich of the Black Ledger
text: When Malgrith enters, return target creature card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to play. At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
flavor: "Death is only a creditor, and I have never paid a creditor in my life." (Malgrith, Lich of the Black Ledger)

name: The Black Contract
text: Enemy creatures get -1/-1. At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.
flavor: "Read nothing. Sign everything. Regret is a clause for later." (the Black Contract, preamble)

name: Azgaroth, Duke of the Ninth Pit
text: Dread. Other Demons you control have deathtouch. (Any damage they deal to a creature destroys it.) Whenever another Demon enters under your control, the enemy player discards a card at random. When Azgaroth enters, you lose 3 life.
flavor: "Every man in my court is free. He is free to pay, and free to pay again." (Azgaroth, Duke of the Ninth Pit)

name: Kharnoth, the Bone Marshal
text: Other Skeletons you control get +1/+1 and have dread. (They can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.) Whenever Kharnoth attacks, create a 1/1 Risen Bones Skeleton token.
flavor: "Rest is a rumour. I signed away my bones so they could march forever, and I still call it a bargain." (Kharnoth, the Bone Marshal)

name: Ulgreth, the Carrion King
text: Other Zombies you control get +1/+1. At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 Restless Dead Zombie token. Whenever another Zombie you control dies, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: "Let the righteous wait for the last trumpet. My dead rise every dawn, and it cost me nothing but my soul." (Ulgreth, the Carrion King)

name: Vexhal, Warden of the Brimstone Gate
text: Dread. Other Demons you control get +1/+1. Whenever another Demon enters under your control, the enemy player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
flavor: "Every soldier of mine signed for one battle. The small print says forever, and I wrote the small print." (Vexhal, Warden of the Brimstone Gate)
